title: Publish named whiteboards without changing their siblings
preconditions: Disposable Saga has zeta, Architecture.v2 and data-model boards at r1 with valid source pins.

steps.action: Publish data-model r2 with observed parent r1 and reload each named board.
steps.expected_result: Only data-model advances to r2; the other named boards stay r1.

steps.action: Compare the saved zeta r1 bytes before and after other publications.
steps.expected_result: The sibling immutable revision is byte-for-byte unchanged.
